data.title: Northern Ireland court allows Orange Order march through Catholic area
data.description: A court in Northern Ireland has allowed a Protestant parade to proceed through a controversial route in a Catholic area for the first time in nearly 30 years. The legal dispute ended in the early hours of Sunday, with counterprotests now underway and police working to keep marchers and protesters apart. The Drumcree parade dispute dates back to the mid-1990s, when tensions over the route led to riots, roadblocks and murders, threatening Northern Ireland’s peace process. Hervé Amoric reports from Portadown.

data.title: Pope Leo visits Lourdes pilgrimage site
data.description: After leaving Paris, Pope Leo XIV ended his second day in France in Lourdes, where he prayed at the Grotto of Massabielle, one of the Catholic Church’s major pilgrimage sites. He is the third pope to visit Lourdes, following Benedict XVI and John Paul II. On Sunday, the pontiff is due to celebrate another open-air mass before meeting privately with seven survivors of clerical sexual abuse. A French inquiry found that members of the Church had abused around 330,000 people as minors over seven decades. Catherine Viette reports.

data.title: Switzerland votes on country's neutrality
data.description: As other neutral countries such as Austria and Ireland increase defence spending and strengthen ties with NATO, Swiss voters are taking part in a referendum on whether to enshrine a stricter definition of the country’s centuries-old neutrality in the constitution. Switzerland has not fought a military conflict since neutrality was established in 1815, but some argue that measures such as sanctions can undermine that principle. The vote also raises questions about how neutrality can be maintained amid Europe’s changing security landscape, with Russia at war with Ukraine and the US putting pressure on traditional alliances such as NATO. Josh Vardey reports.

data.title: Belleville, Ont., gathers for annual Porchfest in wake of synagogue attack
data.description: Residents of Belleville, Ont., came together Saturday for an annual neighbourhood music festival, with this year's event also being a way for people to show their support to the community following last weekend's shooting outside a synagogue. The attack, which took place on Yom Kippur, seriously injured a police officer and left the gunman dead.

data.title: London transfer: is it time to kill off the Heathrow Express?
data.description: With fares high and passenger numbers low, plans for a third runway could bring the train’s future into question If Heathrow finally builds its third runway, Londoners can expect hundreds more planes flying overhead each day. But greater congestion on the ground will be a problem too. Under Heathrow’s £33bn expansion plan , 100,000-200,000 more passengers would eventually be travelling to or from the airport each day. The most eye-catching problem has been moving part of the UK’s busiest motorway, the M25, to make space for a new 2.2-mile (3.5km) runway. A thornier one may be getting motorists out of their cars, and finding more sustainable ways for the extra passengers – and thousands of staff – to travel to and from Heathrow. Continue reading...

data.title: The moment I knew: My late fiance’s favourite song was playing – and Billy said ‘Jamie’s here, isn’t that nice?’
data.description: After the death of his partner, Anthony Nocera had almost given up on love. Then Billy walked through the door Find more stories from the moment I knew series In 2024, about 18 months after my fiance Jamie passed away, I decided I was lonely and horny and so put myself out there on the apps. I’d placed Jamie’s ashes on the TV cabinet in the living room, so he was smack bang in the middle of his two favourite places: his spot on the couch and his coffee machine. It also meant he was in the centre of the house, which made dating hard. I had a guy over for a hook-up one night and he kept fixating on the urn. “So … He’s dead?” Continue reading...

data.title: Eviction of 87-year-old puts Spain’s deepening housing crisis in the spotlight
data.description: Images of Maricarmen Abascal being forcibly removed from her home sparked protests and a reckoning over the country’s soaring real estate market Images of an octogenarian being evicted from the home she had lived in for seven decades on a stretcher, flanked by protesters and police officers, sparked indignation across Spain. Hours later, people began taking to the streets. In Madrid, an estimated 10,000 people turned up on Wednesday, wielding signs that read “Shame” and “Out with the vulture funds”, to protest against the eviction of Maricarmen Abascal. From the northern tip of Spain to the south, people poured into plazas calling for a nationwide reckoning over access to housing. Continue reading...

data.title: Northern Ireland live: controversial Orange Order march in Portadown delayed amid huge counter-protest
data.description: Large crowd blocking route march was due to take in Catholic enclave of largely Protestant town Northern Ireland First Minister Michelle O’Neill, at the scene of the counter-protest this morning also spoke alongside Mary Lou McDonald. O’Neill said she had called on Northern Ireland secretary Chris Bryant to intervene. She told reporters: “Does anybody think that this is a good idea? No right-minded person would make this decision. “I still do not know the answer to this question - why, after 28 years of determination to block a march down this road, the Parades Commission thought that this was the right idea today to bring this mess back onto this community?” Local MP Carla Lockhart, from the pro-British Democratic Unionist Party, posted this morning on X describing the marchers as a “dignified grouping of men, walking silently down Garvaghy Road”. She included a photo of the small group in suits, wearing orange silk sashes and black bowler hats and carrying a banner. “There is no threat, no triumphalism, not even music. There is nothing to fear. The rule of law must prevail,” she wrote. Continue reading...

data.title: Ukraine war briefing: German foreign minister urges Russia to abandon dangerous escalation in rare meeting
data.description: The two foreign ministers met on the sidelines of the UN general assembly in New York even though relations have been frozen since the invasion. What we know on day 1,677 The foreign ministers of Russia and Germany met in New York on the sidelines of the ⁠UN general assembly , ⁠in the first such ​talks since Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine. But Russia’s top diplomat dismissed Germany’s calls to ease off its “dangerous path of escalation” toward Europe, instead accusing Germany of being Ukraine’s main sponsor and seeking to be a leading military power in Europe. “Does Berlin understand what this could lead to?” the Russian foreign minister, Sergei Lavrov, asked in his speech at the gathering of world leaders on Saturday. “Didn’t they learn the lessons of world war two?” German foreign minister, Johann ‌Wadephul, used the talks to call on Russia “to abandon the dangerous path of escalation vis-a-vis Germany, Europe, and Nato” , according to a delegation source. Wadephul said incidents such as the attempted drone attack in Leipzig would not shake Germany’s resolve to support Ukraine, according to sources. Relations between Moscow and Berlin have been frozen since the Russian invasion , and tensions escalated further after the drone incident at Leipzig airport. In a sign of the continued frostiness, Lavrov told a press conference on Saturday “nothing new” came from the talks with his German counterpart. “I told him that frankly … you could just have called me and said: ‘read my statement’,” Lavrov said . “He simply reiterated his official public position condemning Russia … you can judge for yourself whether that counts as dialogue or not.” Still, the ​ministers discussed bilateral ties and the war in Ukraine, officials from ‌both sides said. Wadephul urged Lavrov to do “everything possible to reach an agreement on grain exports via the Black Sea”, a German ‌delegation source said. In a sign of the sensitivities around meeting the Russian foreign minister , Wadephul notified his European allies of the meeting afterwards in a message seen by Reuters. “I used this opportunity to reiterate our position on Russia’s war of aggression ⁠against Ukraine and to call for an immediate and complete ceasefire, most pressingly with a focus on grain ​exports, and the energy infrastructure,” he wrote. After the meeting Lavrov addressed world leaders at the assembly, where he defended Russia’s war in Ukraine and lobbed barbs at the west — including Germany – and criticised the militarisation of Japan. He made clear that Russia will veto any attempt by Germany and Japan for permanent seats on the UN security council. The two nations fought Russia, Britain and the US in the second world war. Writing on her personal Telegram channel, Maria Zakharova, a spokesperson for Russia’s foreign ministry, said that “tens of diplomats” had come to meet Lavrov to “shake his hand and thank Russia”. An overwhelming majority of general assembly member nations have repeatedly condemned Russia’s invasion of Ukraine , as Wadephul noted in his own address to the assembly Saturday. “Russia’s war targets the lives of millions of innocent people, the existence of the Ukrainian state and culture and the European peace order,” he said, urging Russia to negotiating toward ending the fighting. The talks came amid an intensifying aerial war and as Donald Trump said he hoped the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, would “settle” with Russia’s Vladimir Putin. With frontline positions largely unchanged since last year, Russia has hammered Ukraine with cruise and ballistic missiles, powerful glide bombs and jet-powered drones in recent months, while Ukraine’s long-range drones have targeted Russian oil refineries and businesses. “It is essential that our partners not forget: Russia is escalating every single day,” Zelenskyy wrote on Saturday. “If the Russians have chosen to make their strikes even more brutal, the world must choose stronger responses to keep the war from spreading further.” Ukrainian officials said Russian attacks killed four people on Saturday, as Russian authorities said a Ukrainian drone attack killed three. Residents of Kyiv are preparing for power cuts, drone attacks and a bitter cold winter by stocking up on generators, food and “dry showers”, as the Ukrainian capital becomes a frontline city . And Russia has opened a new front in its campaign against Ukraine , hitting several datacentres and internet providers in Kyiv this week in an apparent attempt to weaken the digital backbone of the economy. Continue reading...

After the meeting Lavrov addressed world leaders at the assembly, where he defended Russia’s war in Ukraine and lobbed barbs at the west — including Germany – and criticised the militarisation of Japan. He made clear that Russia will veto any attempt by Germany and Japan for permanent seats on the UN security council. The two nations fought Russia, Britain and the US in the second world war. Writing on her personal Telegram channel, Maria Zakharova, a spokesperson for Russia’s foreign ministry, said that “tens of diplomats” had come to meet Lavrov to “shake his hand and thank Russia”. An overwhelming majority of general assembly member nations have repeatedly condemned Russia’s invasion of Ukraine , as Wadephul noted in his own address to the assembly Saturday. “Russia’s war targets the lives of millions of innocent people, the existence of the Ukrainian state and culture and the European peace order,” he said, urging Russia to negotiating toward ending the fighting. The talks came amid an intensifying aerial war and as Donald Trump said he hoped the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, would “settle” with Russia’s Vladimir Putin. With frontline positions largely unchanged since last year, Russia has hammered Ukraine with cruise and ballistic missiles, powerful glide bombs and jet-powered drones in recent months, while Ukraine’s long-range drones have targeted Russian oil refineries and businesses. “It is essential that our partners not forget: Russia is escalating every single day,” Zelenskyy wrote on Saturday. “If the Russians have chosen to make their strikes even more brutal, the world must choose stronger responses to keep the war from spreading further.” Ukrainian officials said Russian attacks killed four people on Saturday, as Russian authorities said a Ukrainian drone attack killed three. Residents of Kyiv are preparing for power cuts, drone attacks and a bitter cold winter by stocking up on generators, food and “dry showers”, as the Ukrainian capital becomes a frontline city . And Russia has opened a new front in its campaign against Ukraine , hitting several datacentres and internet providers in Kyiv this week in an apparent attempt to weaken the digital backbone of the economy. data.description: The Londoner is the set designer big names turn to for eye-popping spectacle. As a new retrospective opens, she gives the Guardian a glimpse at her studio Four years ago, the V&A East Storehouse in east London got in touch with Es Devlin. The museum’s curators wanted to invite the British artist and designer to respond to a 100-year-old theatrical backdrop by the Russian artist and designer Natalia Goncharova. For a 1926 London production of The Firebird by the Ballets Russes, Goncharova had painted a fortified Muscovite cityscape festooned with onion domes and spires, rust-red and golden against a deep-blue sky. Devlin didn’t know much about Goncharova. But alighting on the term she had favoured for describing her kaleidoscopic approach to art-making, Devlin realised she’d found a kindred spirit. “She called herself an ‘everythingist’,” Devlin says, a smile in her eyes. data.title: ‘I cannot hear “stuffed vegetables” without flashbacks’
data.description: It has taken me decades to get over the vegetarian cookbooks of my past It would be unwise to overstate things, the world being as it is, but what happened in the UK with stuffed peppers is a tragedy. You know the ones I mean: traffic light bell peppers stuffed with a cupboard raid of rice, breadcrumbs, lentils, nuts and veg – 70s stuffed peppers. The kind you might find in a wholefoods cookbook, cheerfully distended and jaunty of cap, with the physiognomy of PC Plod. I used to make them at university sometimes, my sensibilities being, as ever, several decades out of touch. I think I was trying to channel the vegetarian cookbooks my parents once had – in the years before discovering pesto, these peppers were the vegetarian’s lot. The recipes I concocted bore things like buckwheat groats, curly leaf parsley and yeast extract. To this day, I cannot hear “stuffed vegetables” without flashbacks to such peppers and their generous cargo of junk. It’s a shame, because stuffed vegetables so obviously do not have to be this way. Take chiles rellenos : think about what it takes not just to stuff a poblano, but to blacken it over flame, then to peel off its skin, fill with cheese, secure the seam with a toothpick, coat in flour, dip in fluffy whisked egg, and fry until the batter is crisp and puffed. Continue reading...

data.title: My Instagram reels addiction has ruined my ability to have a conversation. But can I get it back? | Hannah Ewens
data.description: As a journalist, I’m endlessly curious about people – or I was until short-form video made real-life interactions feel like a drag It’s never pleasant to confront something unflattering about yourself, particularly when you catch yourself in the act. Recently I was mid-conversation with a stranger at a party, when I suddenly became conscious of my internal monologue: yes, hurry up, get to the point, you’re going to say this , then that , and what is the takeaway here? This wasn’t the first time I had noticed a shift in my real-life interactions. Over the preceding months, I had felt tired, even irritated, when loved ones so much as veered close to an anecdote or detail about their lives that I thought I had already heard. During interviews I conducted as a journalist, it sometimes took a heroic effort to concentrate on conversations once they failed to be truly stimulating. Ordinarily I am endlessly curious about people, but I couldn’t ignore a creeping feeling that my attention was waning. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? data.title: I’ve made a new friend. But dare I show her the real me? | Polly Hudson
data.description: We hit it off, agreed to meet and suddenly we’re bosom buddies. But oh, the stress of always putting myself in the best possible light I’ve got a new friend. I’m well aware I sound like a five-year-old reporting that, and this is exactly the point: it turns out making friends as an adult is absolutely excruciating. I like this person so much, and have found the whole business of welcoming someone into my fold quite life-affirming, but it’s almost not worth it for the amount of anxiety it has provoked. This is the closest to dating that boring old smug marrieds like me get, and I have never questioned my every thought, action and WhatsApp message more. Thank God she has her blue ticks on, or I’d probably be having sleepless nights. I met her, just like the romcoms promise, when I’d stopped looking. Like, stopped decades ago. My roster was full; I didn’t have time to hang out with the friends I already had, let alone complicating matters by adding another to the mix. It happened unexpectedly, accidentally, in a waiting room for a kids’ activity – a conversation started over my head about a celebrity, and she made an off-the-cuff, funny, sweary comment. It was love at first slight. Continue reading...

data.title: Ever feel you’ve been cheated? Consequences could be profound after Manchester City guilty verdict | Jonathan Wilson
data.description: Premier League could be hit hard by aftermath, while Manchester City fans may know they took 30 years to recover from a guilty verdict in 1906 So it turns out none of that was real. Nothing that happened in English football between 2009-10 and 2017-18 that involved Manchester City actually happened. City beating Manchester United 6-1 at Old Trafford? Fake. Sergio Agüero’s 94th-minute winner to clinch the title in 2012 ? A figment of the imagination. That season City reached 100 points ? Bobby Ewing dreamed it in the shower. Without those successes, City wouldn’t have been in the position they were for the past eight seasons (and 35 of the charges relate to a failure to cooperate with Premier League investigations between 2018 and 2023). The 14 successive wins that took them to the league title in 2018-19 would not have happened without what went before. Neither would the Treble of 2023 or the record four league titles in a row. data.title: Godzilla Minus Zero review – spectacular Japanese action continues franchise’s winning streak
data.description: New York film festival: The follow-up to 2023’s Oscar-winning Godzilla Minus One dazzles with smart social commentary and jaw-dropping effects Even by the standards of older movie stars catching a major second wind later in their careers, Godzilla pulled off an impressive reclamation of the spotlight three years ago. Godzilla Minus One , the most recent reboot featuring the 70-year-old kaiju – the version(s) from his native Japan, mind, not the Americanized one concurrently starring in a series of Warner Bros blockbusters opposite King Kong – wasn’t just another monster-movie success. It fully crossed over, becoming the highest-grossing Japanese-language movie ever released in North America, and won an Academy Award to boot for its terrific visual effects. Now. Japanese Godzilla characters are mainstream enough to pop up in Happy Meals, and the Toho -made sequel Godzilla Minus Zero is world-premiering at the New York film festival. Arguably the artsiest, brainiest of the major fall fests is playing unexpected host to a truly spectacular monster battle royale, packaged alongside some of the same thoughtful historical context that informed the previous film. Writer, director and VFX maestro Takashi Yamazaki returns for the sequel, bringing his lead characters back with him. In the previous film, former military pilot Kōichi Shikishima (Ryunosuke Kamiki) used his experience with Godzilla to overcome his guilt and shame over failing to complete a pointless kamikaze mission toward the end of the second world war – the devastation of which brought Japan back to “zero”, hence a newly emergent Godzilla bringing the country to “minus one”. Minus Zero catches up with Kōichi, his now-wife Noriko (Minami Hamabe), and their adopted daughter Akiko (Sae Nagatani) two years later, in 1949 (although Akiko somehow seems more or less the same age). Another monster threat looms over post-war Japan in the form of a dragon-like creature dubbed Ghidorah, whose menace will be familiar to kaiju fans. (Though he isn’t seen directly in trailers, this isn’t a spoiler; he’s featured from the very first scene of the film.) Continue reading...

data.title: Raye’s I Know You’re Hurting urged me to confront a lifetime of depression
data.description: I had always ignored my anguished mental state or tried to push it aside, and CBT didn’t work for me – then one song seemed to articulate my pain Six months ago, I was driving past John Lewis on the M40 with my wife and stepdaughter, Raye’s I Know You’re Hurting playing on the stereo, when I realised I was crying. It was the third time I’d listened to the song, but it was the first time I’d really heard it. It was as though the lyrics were speaking directly to me: “I can see you standing on the edge … You give when you have little left to give.” Music had made me emotional before, but only ever because of the melody or the arrangement or the orchestration. I have worked in music since I was 21, and as a recording and mix engineer, I’ll listen to a song all day, taking it apart to work out how to make it better. After listening to a song 200 times, it inevitably loses its meaning, and over the years, I’ve become desensitised to the power music can have. But this time, for the first time, it was the lyrics that brought me to tears. Continue reading...

data.title: I hoped my children would have epiphanies while visiting my homeland; my father suggested we go swimming instead
data.description: I brought my children to Penang to immerse them in the places of their grandparents’ stories. When I stopped lecturing them about gratitude and privilege, we enjoyed our final days doing as locals do As I stepped out of Penang international airport, the humidity hit me like I was peering into a just-opened rice cooker. The air carried whiffs of exhaust fumes, fried food and something earthy. It felt thrilling and familiar because I was born in Penang and lived there for six years before I moved to Australia. I looked back at my three children who were visiting for the first time. They were draped over their suitcases like wilted lettuce. “Welcome to Penang,” I said, wiping sweat off my brow. It was July 2026. It had been 13 years since I last visited Penang, when my father had hosted a lavish wedding dinner featuring a champagne fountain and swan-shaped ice sculpture for me and my new husband. For my white, Australian husband, it was a trip of firsts: his first Chinese tea ceremony; his first 10-course banquet; the first time he met my extended family. But for me, it had been the last time I’d spoken Mandarin and the last time I had seen my grandmother before she died. Continue reading...

data.title: The best thing I ever ate? Mum’s boeuf à la mode on my 21st birthday
data.description: She prepared a miraculous feat for my celebration. The very thought of it still makes me smile Though we were nurtured by Mum’s cooking daily, my parents’ brood thought little of the effort required, though we devoured the efforts made. It wasn’t until later in life, having donned the mantle of cook as a career, did I begin to appreciate quite what was required to feed a large, boisterous family well. For the most part, we ate simple Scots fare – lentil soup, mince and tatties, suet puddings – but, on occasion, Mum would sit at the counter, trawling through her favourite books, cigarette in hand, and, indicating a find, would duly pen a shopping list. One such instance was for a birthday feast – Mum’s and mine, for I was born on Mum’s birthday – and the date was the 21 st . And this particular birthday was my 21 st . Birthdays for the most part were celebrated by just the family around the table at home, and, usually in both Mum and Dad’s hands: the triumphant entrance of a splendid cake, made in whichever child’s favourite flavour (chocolate for my sister, while I adored a spiced fruit cake, thickly iced). I always felt that mum’s birthday was overshadowed by mine, which seemed somewhat unfair. So, for this celebration, I volunteered to bake a cake – an offer she kindly accepted. And so Mum graciously relinquished her kitchen – in itself quite something, for the kitchen was her domain – but more of that anon. Continue reading...

data.description: Ten years ago, the San Francisco 49ers quarterback refused to stand for the national anthem. He was accused of disrespecting the flag, the game, and America. In a rare interview, he talks about inspiring a global gesture of civil rights Colin Kaepernick still gets up at 4.30am every morning to train. “Strength training, speed training, position training – still do all of the same type of workouts I did while I was playing,” he says cheerily. “And then go about the rest of my day.” It is almost 10 years since Kaepernick last played a game of top-flight football. His career was abruptly and cruelly cut short just as it was peaking, after the National Football League (NFL) effectively closed ranks and shut him out for being too political. Now, at 38 years old, he is well aware that his chances of a return are dwindling by the day, but he remains as game-ready as ever. “I stay relentless at it,” he continues in his easy drawl. “I look at it from the perspective of, ‘What are the things that I can control?’ And what I know I can control is being prepared for when opportunity knocks, and to also continue knocking, on my end, looking for ways and opportunities … just staying resilient and focused and disciplined – that is what’s gotten me to this point in my life.” Kaepernick’s story is defined by the events of late 2016, when he repeatedly refused to stand for the pre-game national anthem – resulting in a chorus of booing on the pitch, insults and outrage off it, and exclusion from the sport he still loves. He was one of the biggest names in the game at the time; quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers, a national celebrity, sponsored by major brands, and looking back, his actions fed into so much that has happened since: the rise of Donald Trump, the Black Lives Matter protests and a global reckoning with racism, then the backlash against what is now being called “Woke 1.0”, and the resurgence of a white nationalism that the US complacently assumed was in the past. According to the US Department of Justice, she used the organisation's funds for personal expenses including utility bills, Netflix, Six Flags, lingerie, softball gear and home theatre equipment. Her sentencing is scheduled for December 17, 2026.

data.title: Oklahoma is home to seven venomous snakes, from Rattlesnakes and Copperheads to Cottonmouths
data.description: Oklahoma is home to seven species of venomous snakes, all classified as pit vipers. These snakes include the Prairie Rattlesnake, Timber Rattlesnake, Western Cottonmouth, and others. Each species shares common traits, such as triangular-shaped heads and heat-sensing pits. Various habitats are inhabited by these snakes, from wetlands to forested areas. Identifying characteristics, including coloration and patterns, assist in recognizing each species.

data.title: How Kenya’s sacred Mrima Hill became new front in US-China minerals rivalry
data.description:

Hong Kong district councillor Peggy Wong Pik-kiu has resigned from office and several other community roles citing health reasons, following mounting controversy over her team’s alleged proxy-vote collection before last year’s fatal Wang Fuk Court inferno.
Wong, a directly elected district councillor for the Tai Po South constituency, also stepped down from her duties as a member of the Tai Po South Area Committee and captain of the Tai Po Kwong Fuk and Plover Cove subdistrict care team.

data.title: The explosive true story of Johnny ‘Mad-dog’ Adair
data.description: Todays episode of The Indo Daily is brought to you by our sister podcast, The BelTel. Johnny Adair, commonly referred to as ‘Mad dog Adair’, was one the most well-known terror bosses of the Troubles. He said his war was aimed at the IRA, but innocent Catholics were more often than not his real victims. His C Company of the west Belfast UDA also turned their guns on their fellow loyalists. Who is Mad dog Adair, what does he believe, and how does he view his murderous reign? Ciarán Dunbar is joined by Aaron Edwards, a Senior Lecturer in Defence and International Affairs at the Royal Military Academy Sandhurst and author of ‘Enemies within: The explosive true story of Johnny ‘Mad dog’ Adair’.

data.title: El Niño esvazia ninhos e ameaça colônia de pinguins no Peru
data.description: Os pinguins-de-humboldt são mais resistentes do que outras espécies. Batizados em referência à corrente de Humboldt, rica em plâncton, que flui da Antártida em direção à América do Sul , ao longo dos séculos eles se adaptaram a ciclos de escassez e abundância determinados pela presença ou ausência do El Niño . A cada dois a sete anos, o fenômeno climático traz águas quentes do oeste, afugentando os peixes de águas frias dos quais os pinguins dependem. Leia mais (09/27/2026 - 05h00)
data.translatedTitle: El Niño empties nests and threatens penguin colony in Peru
data.translatedDescription: Humboldt penguins are more resilient than other species. data.translatedTitle: No crickets

data.title: Familjens klipp – drömhus och stuga under miljonen
data.description: Priserna på den svenska husmarknaden har skenat – utom i Kramfors. Familjen Gepertz flyttade till landets enda kommun med sjunkande priser – och fyndade en sekelskiftesvilla för under en miljon kronor. – Vi fick vårt drömhus, säger Ellinor Gepertz.
data.translatedTitle: The family clip – dream house and cottage under a million
data.translatedDescription: Prices on the Swedish housing market have skyrocketed - except in Kramfors. The Gepertz family moved to the country's only municipality with falling prices - and found a turn-of-the-century villa for under one million kroner. - We got our dream house, says Ellinor Gepertz.

data.title: Förnuftet segrar i allkonstverk om Galileis liv
data.description: När Niklas Hjulström sätter upp Brechts ”Galileis liv” på Västmanlands teater använder han skådespelarna som spelkort: alla får sin plats och sitt ljus och regin plockar självsäkert hem föreställningen, stick efter stick. Ingegärd Waaranperä ser ett allkonstverk där slamret från nyss uppfunna maskiner ger framtidshopp.
data.translatedTitle: Reason prevails in works of art about Galileo's life
data.translatedDescription: When Niklas Hjulström stages Brecht's "The Life of Galileo" at Västmanland's theater, he uses the actors as playing cards: everyone gets their place and their light, and the director confidently picks up the performance, piece by piece. Ingegärd Waaranperä sees a work of art where the clatter of newly invented machines gives hope for the future.

data.title: Kostnaden för kriget måste öka om Putin ska ruckas
data.description: Ryssland betalar ett högt pris för kriget, men visar inga tecken på att backa. Ukraina fortsätter vädja om vapen. Så vilket stöd skulle räcka för att få Ryssland på knä? Och för hur länge då?
data.translatedTitle: The cost of the war must increase if Putin is to be shaken
data.translatedDescription: Russia is paying a heavy price for the war, but shows no signs of backing down. Ukraine continues to plead for arms. So what support would be enough to bring Russia to its knees? And for how long then?

data.title: Sara Kristoffersson: Kungahusens souvenirshoppar har blivit dyra livsstilsbutiker
data.description: Linneservetter, brickor, tallrikar, doftljus, kakor och lampor – på hyllorna i kungahusens butiker trängs allt fler inredningsprylar. I en tid när varor ska marknadsföras genom en berättelse kan få företag konkurrera med den kungliga historien, skriver Sara Kristofersson.
data.translatedTitle: Sara Kristoffersson: Kungahusen's souvenir shops have become expensive lifestyle shops
data.translatedDescription: Linen napkins, trays, plates, scented candles, cakes and lamps - the shelves in the royal houses' stores are crowded with more and more interior items. In an age when goods must be marketed through a story, few companies can compete with the royal story, writes Sara Kristofersson.

data.title: Insändare. Döm inte de inblandade i Borlänge för hårt
data.description: INSÄNDARE. Det är inte alls underligt att Tidöpartiernas utvisningspolitik fått påtaglig effekt på Vänsterpartiets röstandel i invandrartäta områden. Döm därför inte de inblandade för hårt, skriver Louise Lotta Ålund, tidigare skolsköterska på Tjärnaskolan i Borlänge.
data.translatedTitle: Letter to the editor. Don't judge those involved in Borlänge too harshly
data.translatedDescription: LETTER TO THE EDITOR. It is not at all surprising that the Tidöpartien's deportation policy had a tangible effect on the Left Party's vote share in areas dense with immigrants. Therefore, do not judge those involved too harshly, writes Louise Lotta Ålund, former school nurse at Tjärnaskolan in Borlänge.

data.title: Är "Antikrist" ett försök att dra ned brallorna på Lars von Trier?
data.description: När skräckfilmen ”Antichrist” blir teater härskar onekligen ett konstnärligt kaos på scenen. Frågan är vad Dramatens uppsättning egentligen har att säga utöver det, skriver Jacob Lundström.
data.translatedTitle: Is "Antichrist" an attempt to pull the strings on Lars von Trier?
data.translatedDescription: When the horror film "Antichrist" becomes a theater, artistic chaos undeniably reigns on the stage. The question is what Dramaten's production actually has to say beyond that, writes Jacob Lundström.

data.title: Hasan Ramic: Svenska hiphoppare har mer att tacka Doggelito för än de vill erkänna
data.description: Dokumentärfilmen om Dogge Doggelito skildrar den osäkra tillvaron bakom artistlivet och blottar villkor som påminner om ett gigjobb, skriver DN:s Hasan Ramic.
data.translatedTitle: Hasan Ramic: Swedish hip-hoppers have more to thank Doggelito for than they want to admit
data.translatedDescription: The documentary film about Dogge Doggelito depicts the precarious existence behind the artist's life and exposes conditions reminiscent of a gig job, writes DN's Hasan Ramic.

data.title: Fossila spybollar avslöjar svanödlornas matvanor
data.description: De stora svanödlorna livnärde sig ute till havs, men närmade sig land när det var dags att spy upp snäckskal och annan bråte. Den slutsatsen drar paleontologen Dirk Knaust efter att ha studerat borrkärnor från norska oljeprovborrningar.
data.translatedTitle: Fossil spitballs reveal the eating habits of swan lizards
data.translatedDescription: The large swan lizards fed out at sea, but approached land when it was time to regurgitate shells and other debris. Paleontologist Dirk Knaust draws that conclusion after studying drill cores from Norwegian oil test drilling.

data.title: Bokmässan ställer in Stefan Holms programpunkter efter polisanmälan
data.description: Idrottsprofilen Stefan Holm misstänks för att ha misshandlat journalisten och poddaren Emil Persson i samband med Bokmässan. Nu ställs Holms programpunkter på Bokmässan in. – Det ska vara en man som har tagit strypgrepp på en annan man, säger Caroline Nylander, presstalesperson på polisen.
data.translatedTitle: The book fair cancels Stefan Holm's program items after the police report
data.translatedDescription: The sports profile Stefan Holm is suspected of having abused the journalist and podcaster Emil Persson in connection with the Book Fair. Now Holm's program items at the Book Fair are cancelled. - It must be a man who has strangled another man, says Caroline Nylander, spokesperson for the police.

data.title: Jessica: Vem är det som är en åsna på loppisen, egentligen?
data.description: Andrahand är nästan alltid mitt förstahandsval. Men när första handen är densamma som den andra försvinner poängen. Bara en åsna köper tillbaka något som den själv slängt eller skänkt bort.
data.translatedTitle: Jessica: Who's a donkey at the flea market, anyway?
data.translatedDescription: Secondhand is almost always my first choice. But when the first hand is the same as the second, the point is lost. Only a donkey buys back something that it itself threw away or gave away.

data.title: Åsa Beckman: Jag kan inte för mitt liv förstå varför det skulle vara fel med boklistor?
data.description: Bokmässan pågår och det diskuteras Pisarapporter, dataspel, ny bibelöversättning – och boklistor. Kan man tävla i litteratur? Är boklistor fördärvliga? Eller är de, som DN:s Åsa Beckman skriver, ett bra komplement till kritiken?
data.translatedTitle: Åsa Beckman: I cannot for the life of me understand why it would be wrong with book lists?
data.translatedDescription: The book fair is underway and there is discussion of Pisa reports, computer games, new Bible translation - and book lists. Can you compete in literature? Are book lists pernicious? Or are they, as DN's Åsa Beckman writes, a good complement to the criticism?

data.title: Peter Wolodarski: Putin kör fast i Ukraina, då försöker han skrämma resten av Europa
data.description: Allt fler varnar för att Putin kan komma att angripa Nato. Det finns en mörk logik bakom hans agerande.
data.translatedTitle: Peter Wolodarski: Putin gets stuck in Ukraine, then he tries to scare the rest of Europe
data.translatedDescription: More and more people are warning that Putin may attack NATO. There is a dark logic behind his actions.

data.title: I ny final – hur kan Nordkorea dominera ungdomsfotbollen på damsidan?
data.description: Nordkorea har hittat en arena där landets flagga kan vaja högst. U17-landslaget är regerande världsmästare. U20-landslaget likaså. På söndagen kan nästa titel komma. Hur kan en av världens mest isolerade stater dominera ungdomsfotbollen på damsidan?
data.translatedTitle: In new finals - how can North Korea dominate youth football on the women's side?
data.translatedDescription: North Korea has found an arena where the country's flag can fly highest. The U17 national team is the reigning world champion. The U20 national team as well. On Sunday, the next title may come. How can one of the world's most isolated states dominate youth football on the women's side?

data.title: Äggrekryteraren: De ska vara ljusa och långa
data.description: Rekryteraren Alejandra Hernandes Lesmes letar efter ljushåriga kvinnor över 157 centimeter. Deras äggceller är de utländska kunderna villiga att betala mycket pengar för. – Folk vill ha barn som liknar dem själva, säger hon.
data.translatedTitle: The egg recruiter: They should be bright and long
data.translatedDescription: Recruiter Alejandra Hernandes Lesmes is looking for fair-haired women over 157 centimeters. Their egg cells are what the foreign customers are willing to pay a lot of money for. - People want children who look like themselves, she says.

data.title: DN:s avslöjande om äggdonatorerna i fem punkter
data.description: Surrogatbranschen har vuxit till en miljardindustri. I centrum står klinikernas hemliga äggdonatorer. Nu kan DN avslöja sanningen bakom sekretessen.
data.translatedTitle: DN's disclosure about the egg donors in five points
data.translatedDescription: The surrogacy industry has grown into a billion dollar industry. At the center are the clinics' secret egg donors. Now DN can reveal the truth behind the secrecy.

data.title: De säljer sex – och sina ägg
data.description: Kvinnorna påstås vara studenter som vill hjälpa barnlösa svenskar att bli föräldrar. Vi hittar dem här: i fönsterlösa bås, där unga latinamerikanska tjejer får betalt för att låtsas tillfredsställa sig själva framför en webbkamera. Dagens Nyheter kan nu avslöja sanningen bakom surrogatbranschens hemliga äggdonatorer.
data.translatedTitle: They sell sex – and their eggs
data.translatedDescription: The women are allegedly students who want to help childless Swedes become parents. We find them here: in windowless booths, where young Hispanic girls are paid to pretend to please themselves in front of a webcam. Dagens Nyheter can now reveal the truth behind the surrogate industry's secret egg donors.

data.title: ”Jag vill veta sanningen om äggdonatorerna”
data.description: Niklas Thenstedts bebis ska växa i en mage på andra sidan jorden. Nu undrar han om äggdonatorn – barnets genetiska mamma – är en del av Colombias livesexindustri. – Jag vill att sanningen ska komma fram, för mitt framtida barns skull, säger Niklas.
data.translatedTitle: "I want to know the truth about the egg donors"
data.translatedDescription: Niklas Thenstedt's baby will grow in a stomach on the other side of the world. Now he wonders if the egg donor - the child's genetic mother - is part of Colombia's live-sex industry. - I want the truth to come out, for the sake of my future child, says Niklas.

data.title: Ledare: Magdalena Andersson kan inte vänta på Vänsterpartiet
data.description: Först vägrade vänsterpartisterna att gå på möten med S, C och MP där sakpolitik ska diskuteras. Nu vågar de sig knappt ut från partikansliet. S-ledaren måste börja utan dem.
data.translatedTitle: Leader: Magdalena Andersson can't wait for the Left Party
data.translatedDescription: First, the left-wing parties refused to go to meetings with S, C and MP where policy is to be discussed. Now they hardly venture out of the party office. The S leader must start without them.

data.title: Oskar Linnros drar fram en osannolik hitkavalkad
data.description: När lamporna släcks på Avicii arena har Oskar Linnros gett publiken allt den vill ha, skriver DN:s Vera von Otter.
data.translatedTitle: Oskar Linnros pulls off an unlikely hit parade
data.translatedDescription: When the lights go out at the Avicii arena, Oskar Linnros has given the audience everything they want, writes DN's Vera von Otter.

data.title: Här är de fem mest välklädda gubbarna på stan
data.description: En har inte använt jeans sedan han var 12 år, en annan har blivit korad till ”veckans elegans” och en tredje har alltid slips. Grundaren av kontot Gubbstil, Erik Östling, korar de fem bäst klädda gubbarna på stan – i alla fall den här förmiddagen. För DN berättar männen hur de tänker när de klär sig på morgonen.
data.translatedTitle: Here are the five best-dressed men in town
data.translatedDescription: One has not worn jeans since he was 12 years old, another has been crowned "Elegance of the Week" and a third always wears a tie. The founder of the Gubbstil account, Erik Östling, ranks the five best-dressed old men in town - at least this morning. For DN, the men tell what they think when they get dressed in the morning.

data.title: Han fotograferar gubbar på stan: ”Modemässig världsklass”
data.description: På sociala medier har äldre män blivit stilikoner för en yngre generation. Men vad kännetecknar en riktigt bra gubbklädsel? DN följer med Erik Östling när han spanar efter välklädda herrar på stan till sitt Instagramkonto Gubbstil.
data.translatedTitle: He photographs old men in the city: "Fashionable world class"
data.translatedDescription: On social media, older men have become style icons for a younger generation. But what characterizes a really good old man outfit? DN follows Erik Östling as he scouts for well-dressed men in town for his Instagram account Gubbstil.

data.title: William attackerades av häst i Lidingöloppet – sprang i mål
data.description: Lidingöloppet är en utmaning för de flesta. Ännu värre var det för William Blomqvist som attackerades av en häst med 25 kilometer kvar. Trots en inre blödning i höften och en bruten stortå slutförde han loppet på tiden 3.45.47. – Jag blev ju lite förvånad, det är det sista man tror ska hända på ett motionslopp.
data.translatedTitle: William was attacked by a horse in the Lidingö Race - ran to the finish line
data.translatedDescription: The Lidingö race is a challenge for most people. It was even worse for William Blomqvist who was attacked by a horse with 25 kilometers to go. Despite internal bleeding in the hip and a broken big toe, he completed the race in a time of 3.45.47. - I was a little surprised, it's the last thing you think should happen in an exercise race.

data.title: Uppgifter: S och V planerar att träffas på söndag
data.description: Källor i S och V har under dagen gett olika besked om varför partierna inte har träffats under veckan. Samtidigt närmar sig deadline för de rödgröna att nominera sin talmanskandidat, och V har öppnat för att rösta på Tidösidans Andreas Norlén. Nu uppger en V-källa för Aftonbladet att ett möte på partiledarnivå planeras till söndagen.
data.translatedTitle: Details: S and V plan to meet on Sunday
data.translatedDescription: Sources in S and V have during the day given different information about why the parties have not met during the week. At the same time, the deadline for the red-greens to nominate their speaker candidate is approaching, and V has opened to vote for Tidösidan's Andreas Norlén. Now a V source tells Aftonbladet that a meeting at party leader level is planned for Sunday.

data.title: Stefan Holm attackerade Emil Persson vid Bokmässan
data.description: Den tidigare höjdhopparen Stefan Holm uppger att han är misstänkt för att ha misshandlat journalisten och poddprofilen Emil Persson utanför en restaurang i anslutning till Bokmässan i Göteborg på lördagen. – Jag har polisanmält honom, det är bäst att invänta utredningen, säger Emil Persson till SVT.
data.translatedTitle: Stefan Holm attacked Emil Persson at the Book Fair
data.translatedDescription: The former high jumper Stefan Holm states that he is suspected of having assaulted the journalist and podcast profile Emil Persson outside a restaurant in connection with the Book Fair in Gothenburg on Saturday. - I have reported him to the police, it is best to wait for the investigation, says Emil Persson to SVT.

data.title: 26 september: Missa inte dagens nyheter
data.description: Katastroftillstånd utlyst i Bangkok, Norrlandspartiet gör succéval och strid om grevens arv – här är dagens nyheter.
data.translatedTitle: September 26: Don't miss today's news
data.translatedDescription: A state of emergency has been declared in Bangkok, the Norrland Party makes a successful election and the fight over the Count's inheritance - here is today's news.

data.title: Elisabeth Hjorth: För en Jesusbrud känns den nya bibelöversättningen bra
data.description: Nyöversättningen av Nya Testamentet är också litterär. Författaren Elisabeth Hjorth berättar om när hon som ung satt ensam i källaren och strök under i Bibeln med rödpenna medan de andra syndade i baksätet på en Volvo.
data.translatedTitle: Elisabeth Hjorth: For a Jesus bride, the new Bible translation feels good
data.translatedDescription: The new translation of the New Testament is also literary. The author Elisabeth Hjorth tells about when, as a young woman, she sat alone in the basement and crossed out the Bible with a red pen while the others sinned in the back seat of a Volvo.

data.title: Vita sydafrikaner markerar mot Trump – med 1 500 fotbollar
data.description: I Washington restes på lördagen 3 000 kors till minne av mördade vita markägare i Sydafrika. Ultrakonservativa grupper som fått Donald Trumps stöd ligger bakom den hårt kritiserade aktionen. Samtidigt radades 1 500 fotbollar upp utanför Johannesburg – i en protest mot Trump.
data.translatedTitle: White South Africans mark against Trump — with 1,500 footballs
data.translatedDescription: In Washington on Saturday, 3,000 crosses were erected in memory of murdered white landowners in South Africa. Ultra-conservative groups that have received Donald Trump's support are behind the heavily criticized action. Meanwhile, 1,500 footballs were lined up outside Johannesburg - in a protest against Trump.

data.title: AI-bild på svenska riksdagsledamöter sprids över världen: ”Känner obehag”
data.description: En bild på de fem riksdagsledamöterna med somalisk bakgrund har spridits över världen den senaste veckan. Den lyfts fram antingen som en symbol för hopp och representation – eller som slagträ i ett rasistiskt narrativ. Bilden är inte äkta utan skapad med AI. – Jag känner inte vissa av de här personerna och har inte fotats med någon av dem, säger riksdagsledamoten Leila Ali Elmi (MP).
data.translatedTitle: AI image of Swedish parliamentarians spread around the world: "Feels uncomfortable"
data.translatedDescription: A picture of the five members of parliament with a Somali background has been spread around the world in the past week. It is highlighted either as a symbol of hope and representation – or as a bat in a racist narrative. The image is not real but created with AI. - I do not know some of these people and have not been photographed with any of them, says Member of Parliament Leila Ali Elmi (MP).

data.title: DN Debatt. ”Sanningskommissionen är en del av samernas osynliggörande”
data.description: DN DEBATT. Om några dagar ska Sanningskommissionen lämna över sitt slutbetänkande till regeringen. Men deras slutsatser, som kan påverka politiska beslut och människors liv, riskerar att hamna helt fel. De bygger nämligen på alldeles för svaga fakta. Resultatet blir inte upprättelse för samerna, utan ett nytt osynliggörande, skriver historieprofessor Jonny Hjelm.
data.translatedTitle: DN Debate. "The truth commission is part of the invisibility of the Sami"
data.translatedDescription: DN DEBATE. In a few days, the Truth Commission will hand over its final report to the government. But their conclusions, which can influence political decisions and people's lives, risk being completely wrong. They are based on far too weak facts. The result will not be vindication for the Sami, but a new invisibility, writes history professor Jonny Hjelm.

data.title: Lavrov: Vi ska nå våra militära mål i Ukraina
data.description: Rysslands utrikesminister Sergej Lavrov varnar Ukraina och dess allierade om att den ryska ”militära insatsen” ska nå sina uppsatta mål ”oavsett omständigheterna”.
data.translatedTitle: Lavrov: We will achieve our military goals in Ukraine
data.translatedDescription: Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov warns Ukraine and its allies that the Russian "military effort" must achieve its goals "regardless of the circumstances".

data.title: Robotar flygs in bakom frontlinjen och slår till: ”Som en gömma”
data.description: Fjärrstyrda robotar som flygs in bakom fiendens linje – taktiken uppges ha bidragit till att tusentals ryska soldater dödats de senaste månaderna. Robotarna kan gå till attack omedelbart eller flera dagar senare. – Man lägger ut en liten gömma, säger Johan Huovinen på Försvarshögskolan.
data.translatedTitle: Robots are flown in behind the front line and strike: "Like a hide"
data.translatedDescription: Remote-controlled robots flown in behind enemy lines — the tactic is said to have contributed to the deaths of thousands of Russian soldiers in recent months. The robots can attack immediately or several days later. - You put out a small hide, says Johan Huovinen at the Norwegian Defense University.

data.title: Smockan hänger i luften när Huang söker jobb
data.description: GUANGZHOU. Kina skapade hundratals miljoner jobb under 40 år och blev världens verkstadsgolv. Nu försvinner i stället arbetstillfällen. Företag pressar varandra i ursinnig konkurrens och arbetare får se lönen sjunka. På en gata i södra Kinas textilhuvudstad hotar slagsmål när dagens jobb delas ut.
data.translatedTitle: The smock hangs in the air as Huang looks for a job
data.translatedDescription: GUANGZHOU. China created hundreds of millions of jobs over 40 years and became the world's workshop floor. Now jobs are disappearing instead. Businesses are squeezing each other in fierce competition and workers are seeing their wages drop. data.title: Alarm za alarmem. Rosja nie musi atakować Polski, aby zużywać jej obronę

W efekcie uderzenia wymierzone wyłącznie w cele na Ukrainie mogą uruchamiać kosztowną reakcję polskiego systemu obronnego.

As a result, strikes aimed only at targets in Ukraine may trigger a costly response from the Polish defense system.

data.title: Beton, który „zjada” CO2. Naukowcy stworzyli niezwykle wytrzymałą mieszankę
data.description: Powstał nowy rodzaj betonu, który jest mocniejszy od tradycyjnego, a jednocześnie pochłania dwutlenek węgla z atmosfery. Wyniki badań, opublikowane w czasopiśmie „Carbon Research”, wskazują, że dodanie odpowiednio dobranych naturalnych materiałów może sprawić, że beton zyska dodatkową funkcję – poza zastosowaniem konstrukcyjnym będzie także pomagał usuwać CO2 z otaczającego powietrza.
data.translatedTitle: Concrete that "eats" CO2. Scientists have created an extremely durable mixture
data.translatedDescription: A new type of concrete has been created that is stronger than traditional ones and at the same time absorbs carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. The research results, published in the journal "Carbon Research", indicate that adding appropriately selected natural materials can give concrete an additional function - apart from its structural use, it will also help remove CO2 from the surrounding air.

data.title: Mniej podróży, więcej na hobby. Nowe nawyki amerykańskich konsumentów
data.description: Rozrywka w Stanach Zjednoczonych staje się coraz droższa, ale Amerykanie nie zamierzają na niej oszczędzać. Chętnie wydają pieniądze na różnorodne pasje – od aktywności w plenerze po gry.
data.translatedTitle: Less traveling, more hobbies. New habits of American consumers
data.translatedDescription: Entertainment in the United States is becoming more and more expensive, but Americans do not intend to save on it. They willingly spend money on a variety of passions - from outdoor activities to games.

data.title: AfD ma być wielka. „Zalecałbym Polakom fortyfikowanie granicy na Odrze i Nysie”
data.description: Nacjonalistyczna AfD uważa, że już przejęła w Niemczech przewodnią rolę CDU. – Jak przejmie władzę, pojawi się chęć podzielenia się Polską z Rosjanami – wieszczy w rozmowie z „Rzeczpospolitą” publicysta i pisarz z Erfurtu.
data.translatedTitle: AfD is supposed to be great. "I would recommend Poles to fortify the border on the Oder and Neisse"
data.translatedDescription: The nationalist AfD believes that it has already taken over the leading role of the CDU in Germany. – When he takes power, there will be a desire to share Poland with the Russians – says a publicist and writer from Erfurt in an interview with "Rzeczpospolita".

data.title: Wybory na prezydenta Krakowa. Trwa głosowanie
data.description: W Krakowie trwają przedterminowe wybory na prezydenta miasta. Lokale wyborcze będą otwarte do godz. 21.
data.translatedTitle: Elections for the president of Krakow. Voting is in progress
data.translatedDescription: Early elections for the mayor of the city are underway in Krakow. Polling stations will be open until 21.

data.title: Tomasz Terlikowski: Koniec celibatu jako lek na brak księży. Ultimatum z Belgii
data.description: Dysputa nad obowiązkowym celibatem księży rzymskokatolickich trwa de facto od momentu jego wprowadzenia. Teraz jednak sprawa nabiera przyspieszenia za sprawą belgijskiego biskupa.
data.translatedTitle: Tomasz Terlikowski: The end of celibacy as a cure for the lack of priests. Ultimatum from Belgium
data.translatedDescription: The debate over the mandatory celibacy of Roman Catholic priests has been ongoing since its introduction. Now, however, the matter is accelerating thanks to a Belgian bishop.

data.title: Setki milionów euro z UE na pomoc humanitarną. Środki trafią do Afryki i na Ukrainę
data.description: Komisja Europejska planuje przeznaczyć blisko 710 milionów euro na wsparcie humanitarne i zarządzanie migracją. Zastrzyk finansowy ma trafić głównie do państw Afryki Subsaharyjskiej, ale istotna część środków zasili także Ukrainę.
data.translatedTitle: Hundreds of millions of euros from the EU for humanitarian aid. The funds will go to Africa and Ukraine
data.translatedDescription: The European Commission plans to allocate nearly EUR 710 million for humanitarian support and migration management. The financial injection is to go mainly to Sub-Saharan African countries, but a significant part of the funds will also go to Ukraine.

data.title: Waldemar Karpa: Niespokojny Pacyfik. Nowe opisanie bezkresu wód
data.description: Na Pacyfiku krzyżują się dwa procesy, które zdefiniują nasze stulecie. Pierwszy bije w rytmie wielkiej polityki. Drugi postępuje ciszej, we własnym tempie, którego żadna kadencja nie przyspieszy. Wyspiarze muszą wsłuchiwać się w oba naraz – pisze prof. Waldemar Karpa, ekonomista.
data.translatedTitle: Waldemar Karpa: The Troubled Pacific. A new description of the vastness of water
data.translatedDescription: Two processes that will define our century intersect in the Pacific. The first one beats to the rhythm of great politics. The second one proceeds more quietly, at his own pace, which no cadence can speed up. Islanders must listen to both at the same time - writes prof. Waldemar Karpa, economist.

data.title: Czy nadszedł koniec kanclerza Merza?
data.description: Szef rządu RFN wyraźnie liczy na to, że ożywienie gospodarcze pomoże jego partii CDU odzyskać poparcie. Sytuacja ekonomiczna kraju rzeczywiście się poprawiła, ale nie na tyle, by odczuli to zwykli obywatele.
data.translatedTitle: Has the end come for Chancellor Merz?
data.translatedDescription: The head of the German government clearly hopes that economic recovery will help his CDU party regain support. The country's economic situation has indeed improved, but not enough for ordinary citizens to feel it.

data.title: Jakub Sewerynik: Nie wystarczy wysłuchać skrzywdzonych. Wizyta papieża Leona XIV we Francji
data.description: Trudna jest droga od wysłuchania ofiar do konkretnych działań i uznania odpowiedzialności za krzywdy.
data.translatedTitle: Jakub Sewerynik: It is not enough to listen to the wronged. Pope Leo XIV's visit to France
data.translatedDescription: The path from listening to victims to concrete action and acknowledging responsibility for harm is difficult.

data.title: Katarzyna Wróbel-Zumbrzycka: Sprawy spadają z wokand, bo brakuje nominacji
data.description: Ważne, by najważniejsze organy w państwie pośród wielkiej polityki zwracały też większą uwagę na interes ludzi mających swoje sprawy w sądach i samych młodych sędziów – mówi sędzia Katarzyna Wróbel-Zumbrzycka, Stowarzyszenie Sędziów Polskich Iustitia.
data.translatedTitle: Katarzyna Wróbel-Zumbrzycka: Cases fall off the docket because there are no nominations
data.translatedDescription: It is important that the most important authorities in the state, amidst high politics, also pay more attention to the interests of people who have their cases in courts and young judges themselves - says judge Katarzyna Wróbel-Zumbrzycka, Association of Polish Judges Iustitia.

data.title: Tak walczą z wypaleniem i stresem w pracy. Zjawisko „niewidzialnego dnia” rośnie w siłę
data.description: Wypalenie zawodowe i przebodźcowanie cyfrowe skłaniają coraz więcej osób do szukania metod radzenia sobie ze stresem. „Niewidzialny dzień” obiecuje szybki reset układu nerwowego, ale psychologowie ostrzegają: nie każdemu pomoże, a w niektórych przypadkach może wręcz zaszkodzić.
data.translatedTitle: This is how they fight burnout and stress at work. The phenomenon of the "invisible day" is growing
data.translatedDescription: Burnout and digital overstimulation are prompting more and more people to look for ways to deal with stress. "The Invisible Day" promises a quick reset of the nervous system, but psychologists warn: it will not help everyone, and in some cases it may even be harmful.

data.title: Sondaż: Niemal co czwarty Polak uważa sukcesy AfD za zagrożenie dla Polski
data.description: Wyborcze sukcesy Alternatywy dla Niemiec za zagrożenie dla Polski uważa 38,5 proc. uczestników sondażu SW Research dla rp.pl.
data.translatedTitle: Poll: Almost every fourth Pole considers the AfD's successes to be a threat to Poland
data.translatedDescription: 38.5% of people consider the electoral successes of the Alternative for Germany a threat to Poland. participants of the SW Research survey for rp.pl.

data.title: Iran czeka na oficjalną odpowiedź USA. Protest w Madrycie po eksmisji 87-latki
data.description: Przedstawiamy przegląd najważniejszych wydarzeń mijającej nocy: Iran czeka na odpowiedź USA ws. propozycji dotyczącej otwarcia cieśniny Ormuz; MSZ Chin podsumowuje wizytę Xi Jinpinga w USA; wielki protest po eksmisji 87-latki w Madrycie.
data.translatedTitle: Iran is waiting for the official US response. Protest in Madrid after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman
data.translatedDescription: We present an overview of the most important events of the past night: Iran is waiting for the US response regarding the proposal to open the Strait of Hormuz; China's Ministry of Foreign Affairs summarizes Xi Jinping's visit to the USA; large protest after the eviction of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid.

data.title: Czym najtaniej ogrzać dom w tym sezonie? Eksperci porównali koszty pelletu, gazu, węgla i pomp ciepła
data.description: Chłodne dni i noce w ostatnich dniach września spowodowały, że w części mieszkań ogrzewanie już ruszyło. Wydatki na zapewnienie ciepła w domach mogą mocno nadwyrężyć budżet. Eksperci z Polskiego Alarmu Smogowego sprawdzili, które źródło ogrzewania najbardziej się opłaca.
data.translatedTitle: What's the cheapest way to heat your house this season? Experts compared the costs of pellets, gas, coal and heat pumps
data.translatedDescription: Cold days and nights in the last days of September meant that the heating had already started in some apartments. Expenditures on providing heat in homes can put a significant strain on your budget. Experts from the Polish Smog Alert checked which heating source is the most profitable.

data.title: Dočasně se uzavírá část Pražského okruhu. Policie radí, kterému úseku se vyhnout
data.description: Policie ČR v neděli na síti X upozornila, že dálnici D0, tedy Pražský okruh čeká zásadní a neplánované omezení. Od 13:00 bude úsek 16,5 km uzavřen kvůli opravám mostního nosníku. Omezení má trvat nejméně dvě hodiny.
data.translatedTitle: Part of the Prague ring road is temporarily closed. The police advise which section to avoid
data.translatedDescription: On Sunday, the police of the Czech Republic warned on the X network that the D0 highway, i.e. the Prague Ring Road, is facing major and unplanned restrictions. From 1:00 p.m., the 16.5 km section will be closed for bridge girder repairs. The restriction should last at least two hours.

data.title: Trump tlačí na Zelenského. Chci, aby se ještě před zimou dohodl s Putinem, řekl
data.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump v poslední době hovořil s ukrajinským prezidentem Volodymyrem Zelenským a naléhal na něj, aby s ruským vládcem Vladimirem Putinem dosáhl ve válečném konfliktu dohody ještě před zimou. Trump to v sobotu řekl novinářům. Jen za uplynulý měsíc podle Trumpa v konfliktu zahynulo 25 tisíc lidí.
data.translatedTitle: Trump puts pressure on Zelensky. I want him to come to an agreement with Putin before winter, he said
data.translatedDescription: US President Donald Trump recently spoke with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and urged him to reach an agreement with Russian leader Vladimir Putin in the war conflict before winter. Trump told reporters on Saturday. According to Trump, 25,000 people have died in the conflict in the past month alone.

data.title: Jak hlasovat v senátních volbách 2026: bez křížků, zato striktně do žluté obálky
data.description: Češi ve 27 obvodech letos zvolí nové senátory a opět obmění třetinu senátu. První kolo voleb do Senátu 2026 proběhne spolu s komunálními volbami na konci prvního říjnového týdne. Jak volit do Senátu? Hlasování v senátních volbách 2026 je jednoduché, voliči si musí dát pozor jen na dodržení barev.
data.translatedTitle: How to vote in the 2026 senate elections: without crosses, but strictly in a yellow envelope
data.translatedDescription: Czechs in 27 constituencies will elect new senators this year and change a third of the senate again. The first round of the 2026 Senate elections will take place together with the municipal elections at the end of the first week of October. How to vote for the Senate? Voting in the 2026 senate elections is simple, voters only have to pay attention to the colors.

data.title: Státní hrady a zámky se opět otevřely zdarma, kvůli zájmu je lepší rezervace
data.description: Státní hrady, zámky a další památky ve všech krajích se v neděli podruhé otevřely zdarma. Poprvé mohli návštěvníci využít bezplatné prohlídky na konci srpna. Den otevřených dveří se koná ve 106 objektech ve správě Národního památkového ústavu (NPÚ). Podmínkou návštěvy je mít předem zarezervovanou vstupenku na konkrétní čas či okruh.
data.translatedTitle: The state castles and chateaux have opened again for free, due to interest it is better to make a reservation
data.translatedDescription: State castles, chateaux and other monuments in all regions opened for free for the second time on Sunday. For the first time, visitors could take advantage of free tours at the end of August. The open day is held in 106 objects managed by the National Monuments Institute (NÚ). A condition of the visit is to have a pre-booked ticket for a specific time or circuit.

data.title: Narušení vzdušného prostoru samo o sobě neznamená aktivaci článku 5, tvrdí experti
data.description: Narušení vzdušného prostoru členského státu Severoatlantické aliance (NATO) samo o sobě neznamená důvod k aktivaci článku pět o kolektivní obraně. Zásadní by bylo, zda by incident představoval ozbrojený útok, například cílený útok na alianční letoun nebo území členského státu. Vyplývá to z vyjádření bezpečnostních expertů.
data.translatedTitle: Violation of airspace alone does not trigger Article 5, experts say
data.translatedDescription: Violation of the airspace of a North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) member state does not in itself constitute a reason to activate Article Five on collective defence. Crucial would be whether the incident constituted an armed attack, for example a targeted attack on an alliance aircraft or the territory of a member state. This follows from the statements of security experts.

data.title: Motorkářka na Příbramsku sjela ze silnice a havarovala. Na místě zemřela
data.description: Úmrtím řidičky skončila nehoda motocyklu, která se stala v sobotu odpoledne na silnici II/191 na Příbramsku. Řidička ročníku 1982 jela na motocyklu Honda ve směru jízdy od Roželova na Starý Smolivec.
data.translatedTitle: A motorcyclist in the Příbram region ran off the road and crashed. She died on the spot
data.translatedDescription: A motorcycle accident that happened on Saturday afternoon on road II/191 in the Příbram region ended with the death of the female driver. The female driver, born in 1982, was riding a Honda motorcycle in the direction of travel from Roželov to Starý Smolivec.

data.title: Městu chybí dlouhodobá koncepce a lepší komunikace, říká zlínská lídryně STAN
data.description: Zlínské hnutí Starostové a Nezávislí (STAN) ji nejprve oslovilo, zda by chtěla kandidovat do městského zastupitelstva na některé z předních příček. Kariérová poradkyně a pořadatelka akcí Věra Stojar souhlasila. Nakonec dostala nabídku na nejvyšší pozici.
data.translatedTitle: The city lacks a long-term concept and better communication, says Zlín leader STAN
data.translatedDescription: The Zlín Movement of Elders and Independents (STAN) first approached her about whether she would like to run for the city council in one of the leading positions. Career counselor and event organizer Věra Stojar agreed. Finally, she was offered the top position.

ner.entity: Zlín Movement of Elders and Independents
ner.label: ORG

data.title: Při nehodě s čtyřkolkou zemřel 14letý chlapec, spolujezdec skončil v nemocnici
data.description: Při nehodě čtyřkolky na lesní cestě v katastru Jinců na Příbramsku zemřel v sobotu odpoledne chlapec, který čtyřkolku řídil. Druhý chlapec utrpěl podle mluvčí záchranné služby lehčí zranění. Příčiny a okolnosti nehody policie vyšetřuje, řekla v neděli policejní mluvčí Vlasta Suchánková.
data.translatedTitle: A 14-year-old boy died in an accident with a four-wheeler, the passenger ended up in hospital
data.translatedDescription: The boy who was driving the four-wheeler died on Saturday afternoon in a four-wheeler accident on a forest road in the cadastre of Jincő in the Příbram region. The second boy suffered minor injuries, according to a spokesman for the emergency services. The police are investigating the causes and circumstances of the accident, police spokeswoman Vlasta Suchánková said on Sunday.

data.title: Na kole nepřekážím, uvolňuji cestu autům, říká lídr, který by přidal i další bus pruhy
data.description: Za Společně pro Budějovice (KDU-ČSL a TOP 09) kandiduje na primátora Ondřej Talíř. Už učitelka na gymnáziu o něm řekla, že z něj bude politik. „Máme to tak trochu v genech. Snažil jsem se z toho trochu vymanit, že můj táta Jaromír byl ministrem kultury,“ říká třicetiletý lídr.
data.translatedTitle: I don't get in the way on my bike, I clear the way for cars, says the leader who would add more bus lanes
data.translatedDescription: Ondřej Talíř is running for mayor for Together for Budějovice (KDU-ČSL and TOP 09). The teacher at the gymnasium already said about him that he would become a politician. "We kind of have it in our genes. I tried to get out of it a little, that my dad Jaromír was the minister of culture," says the thirty-year-old leader.

data.title: S kalašnikovy postříleli v jihoafrické restauraci hosty. Mrtvé pak obrali o mobily
data.description: Nejméně sedmnáct mrtvých si vyžádala střelba v restauraci ve městě Wedela v Jihoafrické republice, dalších patnáct lidí utrpělo zranění, oznámila v neděli policie. Po pachatelích se stále pátrá. Další střelba v této zemi si v noci na neděli vyžádala deset mrtvých a jedenáct zraněných. Ozbrojení muži stříleli v zábavním podniku u Kapského Města.
data.translatedTitle: They shot guests in a South African restaurant with Kalashnikovs. The dead were then robbed of their mobile phones
data.translatedDescription: At least seventeen people were killed in a shooting at a restaurant in the South African city of Wedela, and another fifteen people were injured, the police announced on Sunday. The search for the perpetrators is still ongoing. Another shooting in the country left ten dead and eleven injured on Sunday night. Gunmen opened fire at an entertainment venue outside Cape Town.

data.title: Rusko zaměřilo své údery na sklady u Kyjeva, častěji útočí i na obchody, říkají data
data.description: Rusko od poloviny června zintenzivnilo své údery na sklady v Kyjevské oblasti, tedy v ukrajinském hlavním městě a jeho okolí. Uvedla to agentura AFP na základě dat nevládní organizace Acled. Počet těchto úderů je nejvyšší od začátku války. Cílem se staly supermarkety, hypermarkety či sklady pohonných hmot.
data.translatedTitle: Russia has focused its strikes on warehouses near Kiev, more often attacking shops as well, the data says
data.translatedDescription: Since mid-June, Russia has intensified its strikes on warehouses in the Kyiv region, i.e. in and around the Ukrainian capital. This was reported by the AFP agency based on data from the non-governmental organization Acled. The number of these strikes is the highest since the beginning of the war. Supermarkets, hypermarkets and fuel depots became the target.

data.title: Vzdělání je prioritní, formuje demokratické myšlení, říká lídryně Milujeme Olomouc
data.description: O hlasy voličů se v komunálních volbách uchází i nová koalice Milujeme Olomouc tvořená Piráty, TOP 09 a Zelenými. Její jednička Lucie Tungul (TOP 09) říká, že i přes nedostatek peněz plynoucích městu od státu má Olomouc na víc. „Jiná města se i v takové situaci dokážou posouvat dál,“ říká v předvolebním rozhovoru iDNES.cz.
data.translatedTitle: Education is a priority, it shapes democratic thinking, says the leader of We Love Olomouc
data.translatedDescription: The new We Love Olomouc coalition consisting of the Pirates, TOP 09 and the Greens is also vying for voters' votes in the municipal elections. Its number one Lucie Tungul (TOP 09) says that despite the lack of money flowing to the city from the state, Olomouc has more to offer. "Other cities can move forward even in such a situation," he says in a pre-election interview with iDNES.cz.

data.title: Na radnici chce jedlík, klaun i bednář. Neobvyklá povolání kandidátů voleb 2026
data.description: Hrobníci, kouzelníci nebo jeden bednář v republice patří na kandidátkách k nejneobvyklejším profesím. Kolonka povolání na volebních lístcích nicméně umožňuje zcela volný styl. Většina kandidátů k ní přistupuje seriózně, maximálně se stručným výčtem svých dovedností či úspěchů pokouší voliče přesvědčit o vlastní volitelnosti. Jiní volí satiru nebo v ní předkládají politické přesvědčení.
data.translatedTitle: He wants an eater, a clown and a cooper at the town hall. Unusual occupations of candidates for the 2026 election
data.translatedDescription: Undertaker, magicians or one cooper in the republic are among the most unusual professions on the candidate lists. However, the occupation field on ballots allows a completely free style. Most candidates approach it seriously, at most they try to convince voters of their electability with a brief list of their skills or achievements. Others choose satire or present political beliefs in it.

data.title: Voda v Odoleně Vodě zůstává nepitná, limit olova překročil čtyřnásobně
data.description: Ranní rozbor vody z horního vodojemu v Odoleně Vodě prokázal více než čtyřnásobné překročení limitu olova, přestože následné odběry už vyhověly a z 24 dnešních testů limit nesplnil jen jeden, voda však nadále není pitná pro 12 obcí s asi 15 tisíci obyvateli.
data.translatedTitle: The water in Odolena Voda remains undrinkable, the lead limit has been exceeded four times
data.translatedDescription: The morning analysis of the water from the upper reservoir in Odolena Voda showed that the limit of lead was exceeded four times, although the subsequent samplings already passed and only one of today's 24 tests did not meet the limit, but the water is still not drinkable for 12 municipalities with about 15,000 inhabitants.

data.title: Kdo nahradí Merze? Tichý zabiják Hendrik Wüst pokukuje po kancléřském křesle
data.description: Kancléřské křeslo se pod Friedrichem Merzem po katastrofických porážkách v zemských volbách povážlivě třese. Křesťanští demokraté hledají nového lídra, pozornost strany se obrací k premiérovi Severního Porýní – Vestfálska Hendriku Wüstovi. Populární lídr nejlidnatější spolkové země se prezentuje jako milující otec, interní zdroje ho označují za tichého zabijáka.
data.translatedTitle: Who will replace Merz? The silent killer Hendrik Wüst is eyeing the chancellor's chair
data.translatedDescription: The chancellor's seat under Friedrich Merz is seriously shaking after the catastrophic defeats in the state elections. The Christian Democrats are looking for a new leader, with the party's attention turning to the Prime Minister of North Rhine-Westphalia, Hendrik Wüst. The popular leader of the most populous federal state presents himself as a loving father, internal sources describe him as a silent killer.

data.title: Göringa zvěčnil v barvě. Byl přátelský, vzpomínal fotograf Norimberského procesu
data.description: Stál pár metrů od nacistických pohlavárů, ve volném čase vyrážel do ulic zpustošeného Norimberku. Raymond D’Addario se v řadách americké armády stal hlavním fotografem procesu, který měl zúčtovat s elitou Hitlerovského Německa. Jeho příběh přinášíme v seriálu Slavné fotografie.
data.translatedTitle: Göring immortalized in color. He was friendly, the photographer of the Nuremberg trials recalled
data.translatedDescription: He stood a few meters from the Nazi leaders, in his spare time he went out into the streets of devastated Nuremberg. In the ranks of the US Army, Raymond D'Addario became the main photographer of the trial, which was supposed to settle accounts with the elite of Hitler's Germany. We present his story in the Famous Photos series.

data.title: Trump dál bojuje s novináři. Stanici CNN nepustí na palubu Air Force One
data.description: Bílý dům nevpustí zpravodajskou televizi CNN na palubu prezidentského letounu Air Force One během sobotní cesty prezidenta Donalda Trumpa. Podle agentury AP naznačil další restrikce vůči části médií po zrušení některých akreditací do sídla prezidenta.
data.translatedTitle: Trump continues to fight journalists. CNN will not be allowed on Air Force One
data.translatedDescription: The White House will not allow CNN news aboard Air Force One during President Donald Trump's trip on Saturday. According to the AP agency, he indicated further restrictions on part of the media after the cancellation of some accreditations to the presidential residence.

data.title: Bangkok zasáhly obří povodně. Premiér zkrátil výjezd, úřady vyhlásily stav ohrožení
data.description: Úřady v Bangkoku vyhlásily kvůli rozsáhlým záplavám stav ohrožení v celé thajské metropoli. Silné deště trvající téměř 48 hodin zaplnily městské kanály a voda zaplavila silnice, domy i obchody. V některých čtvrtích sahala lidem až po stehna, napsala agentura AFP.
data.translatedTitle: Huge floods hit Bangkok. The Prime Minister cut his trip short, the authorities declared a state of emergency
data.translatedDescription: Authorities in Bangkok have declared a state of emergency in the entire Thai capital due to widespread flooding. Heavy rains lasting almost 48 hours filled the city's canals and flooded roads, houses and shops. In some districts, it reached people's thighs, AFP wrote.

data.title: Požár v domě na pražských Vinohradech. Hasiči evakuovali lidi, ulice byla uzavřena
